name: Skill Loop Backend - Scalar Manual Test Plan
description: Ordered, end-to-end manual test plan for every HTTP endpoint in the Skill Loop API, to be executed by hand against the Scalar UI. Steps are in strict dependency order: each step only depends on artifacts produced by earlier steps.

notes: Scalar is served in-process by the Scalar.AspNetCore NuGet package (src/Skill-Loop.Api/Extensions/OpenApiExtensions.cs). No Docker needed for the docs UI.

docs/run-api-local.ps1 points SQL Server at the locally installed instance, creates both databases, and sets Redis__ConnectionString to empty so the app falls back to the in-memory ICacheService. OTPs live in the database and rate limiting is in-process, so nothing else needs Redis.
If you run without that script you must supply your own SQL Server and Hangfire connection strings, since Hangfire never creates its own database.
Both /scalar/v1 and /openapi/v1.json are registered only when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development. The script sets that for you.

steps: Open the Scalar UI URL above.

Start the API FIRST and leave that window open: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs\run-api-local.ps1. It resolves the secrets, creates the Skill-Loop and Skill-Loop-Hangfire databases, and disables Redis.

IMPORTANT - run a collection from the Postman DESKTOP app or the LOCAL agent. A Postman CLOUD agent executes on Postman's own servers, where localhost:7271 means the agent's machine and not yours, so every request fails before reaching the API.
The base URL is https://localhost:7271 (HTTPS, port 7271). Port 7000 only issues a 307 redirect to HTTPS, so pointing the collection at it makes every request look broken.
Execute the steps below in ascending `order`, top to bottom.
When a step declares `capture`, copy the value at the given JSON path from the response and store it in the matching variable (shown in `variables`).
When a step declares `auth`, set the Scalar 'Authentication' selector to the named value, or paste the token manually via the Auth tab.

When a step declares `manualInput`, it consumes a value you must supply out of band (an email code, a token from a link, or an id you have not produced yet). Those are intentional and are listed in the step notes.
When a step declares `skipBeforeOrder`, it is a second, later home for a check that cannot run in its natural position. Run the step at that order instead.
When a step declares `skipIfStepCompleted`, it is mutually exclusive with the named step; run exactly one of the two.
Verify the response status is inside `expectStatus` and that the body matches `expectBody`.

authModes.none: No Authorization header. Leave Scalar Auth as None.
authModes.adminToken: SuperAdmin token WITH permissions, from step S021 (POST /api/v1/Auth/staff/login).
authModes.user2Token: Second student token, from step S029. Used as the 'other user' for chat and reviews.
authModes.instructorToken: Instructor token, from step S053 (re-login after role assignment).
authModes.devAdminToken: Token from S020 (POST /api/v1/dev/quick-login). Identity only, ZERO permissions.

criticalRules: ENUMS IN JSON BODIES MUST BE NUMBERS. No JsonStringEnumConverter is registered (ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs calls AddControllers() with no AddJsonOptions). Sending "level": "Beginner" returns 400; send "level": 1.
ENUMS IN QUERY STRINGS MAY BE NAMES. Query binding is model binding, not System.Text.Json, so ?status=Confirmed works.
TimeSpan fields use the .NET literal string format: "00:30:00".
Dictionary<Guid,int> reorder payloads use quoted GUID strings as keys: { "sectionOrders": { "<guid>": 1 } }.
Property names are camelCase (JsonSerializerDefaults.Web) and are matched case-insensitively.

GET /api/v1/dev/quick-login issues a token with an EMPTY permissions claim list (DevController.cs:47). It satisfies [Authorize] and [AuthenticatedOnly] but every [Permission]-gated command will return 403. Use the real staff login (S021) for all admin work.

POST /api/v1/Auth/user/login also issues a token with an empty permissions list (UserAuthService.cs:77). For endpoints that need permissions, call POST /api/v1/Auth/refresh-token afterwards, which DOES embed permissions (RefreshTokenService.cs:81).

responseEnvelope.successWithData: HTTP 200 with { "data": <payload>, "message": null } - capture paths start at $.data.
responseEnvelope.successNoData: HTTP 204 No Content. This is the SUCCESS case for most Commands, not an error.
responseEnvelope.failure: application/problem+json with { status, title, detail, traceId, correlationId, errors: [ { code, description, type } ] }.

adminEmail.source: Seed:SuperAdmin:Email user-secret. Only exists if you seeded it.

adminPassword.source: YOU MUST FILL THIS IN - it is whatever you set in Seed:SuperAdmin:Password. There is no default password in the codebase any more.

student1ResetOtp.source: S040 email inbox - a SEPARATE code from student1Otp, because OTP purpose is part of the HMAC input

invitationToken.source: S070 response or the invitation email link

runStamp.source: run suffix, keeps unique fields unique per run

promoCode.source: mirrors promoCodeSeed, which the runner scopes per run

roleId.source: S061 select the role under test

rolePermissionIds.source: S062 body -> replayed verbatim by S065

testFilesDir.source: real upload fixtures; run_test_plan.py expands this to an absolute path

coverage.coverageIntent: Every one of the 136 controller actions in src/Skill-Loop.Api/Controllers is covered by at least one step, verified by extracting the [Route] and [Http*] attributes and diffing them against the paths in this file. The 190 steps exceed 136 because 54 extra steps are negative checks that assert a 4xx, plus read-back re-checks that confirm a mutation actually took effect. Steps are ordered so that each artifact (category, course, section, lesson, session, booking, conversation, support question) exists before it is referenced, and destructive calls are pushed to the end of their phase.
coverage.verifiedBy: All paths were diffed against the [Route]/[HttpGet|Post|Put|Patch|Delete] attributes in the controllers. Order was checked to be a contiguous 1..N sequence with no duplicates, phases contiguous, and every {{variable}} produced by a capture at a strictly earlier step (or explicitly flagged manualInput).

Served by UseStaticFiles with no auth. Verify indirectly by opening the avatarUrl from S082 in a browser.

knownGapsFound: UseOpenApiDocumentation() is gated on IsDevelopment(), so /scalar/v1 and /openapi/v1.json are unreachable in Production.
No action declares [ProducesResponseType], so the generated spec still shows no response schemas or status codes.
DashboardsController has no [Authorize]; the spec now correctly shows its three endpoints as public (security: []), which documents the gap rather than hiding it.
api/v1/dev/* is [AllowAnonymous] and guarded only by a runtime IsDevelopment() check, while docker-compose sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development.
Support and TestFiles routes are unversioned (/api/support, /api/test/files) while everything else uses /api/v1.
BuyCreditsCommandHandler is a fake checkout: it credits the wallet without any payment, so any authenticated user can mint unlimited credits. S122a and S188 depend on that behaviour.
fixedWhileWritingThisPlan: components.securitySchemes was absent because AddOpenApi() had no options. BearerSecuritySchemeTransformer now registers BearerAuth, and OperationSecurityTransformer marks each operation from its real [Authorize]/[AllowAnonymous] metadata. Verified against the live spec: 136 operations, 108 secured, 28 anonymous, 0 unmatched.
environmentSkips: S116-S119 and S166-S170: Google Drive upload/download, reported broken. Left as first-class skips rather than re-enabled.
S251: emailing a published FAQ answer needs a real SMTP host; appsettings.json ships MailSettings:Host empty on purpose so the committed config holds no credential.

stepKeyNotes.skip: A reason string. The step is never sent; it still appears in the report as SKIPPED so the coverage stays visible.
stepKeyNotes.pollFor: For a read whose target is written asynchronously. The step is re-issued until the named capture resolves, bounded by seconds/interval. Only ever put it on idempotent steps.
